rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Fitch downgraded Series 2017A/2017B revenue refunding bonds (~$333.3M) from BBB to BBB-. Cited constrained profit margin from EHR installation and unfavorable leverage metrics. Stable outlook reflected expectation of margin recovery post-EHR.

outcome_class_rationale: Single-notch Fitch downgrade in May 2018 (BBB -> BBB-). EHR implementation cost shock + leverage strain.

operating_metrics_fy2016._warning: Industry-typical estimates for affluent Coachella Valley single-hospital system. Debt anchored to known $333M Series 2017 par. Cash position historically strong (philanthropic base).

ma_events_2017_2018._note: Series 2017A/2017B revenue refunding bonds, ~$333.3M. Refinancing event that triggered Fitch's 2018 leverage assessment

_research_notes: EHR install cost shock + leverage metrics caused downgrade. This is a classic 'tech transition' adverse event.
